horecano.note: SUPPLIER, not the brand of these goods. Horecano OOD (EIK 107522685, Sevlievo) is a HoReCa wholesaler with 16,000+ SKUs from 100+ manufacturers — which is why this name spans 91 GS1 prefixes across 91 different makers. The prefix link records SOURCING, not branding: private-label goods keep the contract factory barcode. They DO run a genuine own-brand programme (Horecano Porcelain / HORECANO HOME / HORECANO-BLOOM, collections Alani Blue, Akira, White Moss, Antique Black, Nyx, Gio Amber) and separately distribute Bonna, Pasabahce, Luminarc, Gural, Lacor, LAV, Bormioli. So it is per-PRODUCT: print Horecano only when the product itself carries the name; if the product names another maker, that is the brand; otherwise leave blank.
